title: Court Petitioners Press Bahadur Shah to Act

blocks.text: Even after hearing the complaints, Bahadur Shah hesitates and will not easily turn toward Punjab, while petitioners continue lamenting that the Mughals will be trapped in their homes if Banda is not checked.
The pressure against the emperor intensifies as qazis, faqirs, hajis, and pirs accuse him of failing Islam and abandoning his duty in the face of Khalsa advance.
This page shows paralysis at the center: fear spreads among court petitioners, religious spokesmen, and communities aligned with Mughal authority while authority hesitates upward at court.
